chapter: Day jobs and later Billy and De De engagements
title: De De Pierce and the origin of Eh La Bas
summary: Lewis was around when De De made up the tune, but cannot date it. Older people say it predates De De, though the jazz version is his.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Were you around when Dee Dee made up Beyba Ba?
Well, I was around, yes I was around. It had been many years ago, I can't tell you what year it was.
Do you remember anything about the circumstances?
No, I really don't know because so many people claim it, but from the older people I hear, it's been around before Dee Dee's time.
Oh yes, I know one version of it, but the jazz form of it is his, isn't it?
Well as much as I know, the rest of it I know, it really is, yeah. Yeah.
